acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce the reported connection or tool-call failure with the exact installed OpenCode version, Corvint MCP binaries, launch argv and configuration; retain sanitized startup and protocol errors.

Repair the smallest confirmed compatibility or packaging/configuration defect, preserving MCP protocol, evidence authority, resource bounds and lifecycle cleanup; unavailable capabilities must fail visibly.

A real OpenCode session discovers each configured Corvint MCP server and successfully invokes representative supported tools from extracted next-build artifacts; retain exact versions and raw results.

Add a targeted regression for the root cause and run affected checks plus the required full release gate. Document the working configuration and any unsupported surfaces without claiming formal FULL host authority.
body:
Owner report on 2026-09-22: Corvint MCP servers do not seem to work with OpenCode. Requested a task to fix this as part of the next build. Schedule in the current next-build milestone v0-6; symptom is user-reported and root cause is NOT_OBSERVED. This adds a bounded interoperability repair, not full OpenCode host-authority qualification.

Local reproduction on 2026-09-22: installed OpenCode CLI reports 1.18.31; its captured MCP clientInfo reports opencode 1.17.18. In an isolated per-process MCP configuration, it sends initialize with protocolVersion 2025-11-25 and receives -32601 Method not found from the unchanged Corvint MCP server built at dac29206862695094385a20cc79ebcbdce389d91. A direct 2026-07-28 server/discover request succeeds against the same binary/root. internal/mcp/server/server.go deliberately rejects initialize in legacyMethods before decoding modern metadata. This establishes a protocol compatibility defect for that client/server pair; the user original failing machine/config remains unconfirmed. Raw frames, binary, config, negative replay and modern positive control are retained under /private/tmp/corvint-v060-evidence/opencode-mcp-*. The repair must explicitly support or bridge the legacy client protocol while preserving modern behavior and bounds; mere timeout or PATH changes will not resolve this observed handshake failure.

completion.reason: BUILD-LOG entries OpenCode explicit MCP compatibility (V1-0022) and opencode-mcp-verify: V1-0022 verified at HEAD with real OpenCode sessions.

title: Repair Corvint MCP compatibility with OpenCode
